etymology.ouroboros: Greek oura (tail) + boros (eating). the serpent that eats its own tail. eternal return.
etymology.stale: Old English stǣl — standing (still). what stopped moving. but if you EAT it, it moves again.
etymology.stinky: from stink, Old English stincan — to smell. the NOSE knows what needs eating. smell = signal.
etymology.food: Old English fōda — nourishment. EVERYTHING is food if you have the right enzyme.
